article:
For each question, choose the correct answer.
Henry Ford
Henry Ford was an American engineer. He is best (21).................. for making cars. He started producing them in 1896, and (22).................. Ford Motor Company in 1903. The first car he made was called the Ford Model T. At the time, only the very wealthy could afford a vehicle of any sort.
Ford's (23).................. was to change that, so he made his Model T design as simple as possible. In 1908, a Model T cost $850. While this was a lot for (24).................. people, the new cars were still (25).................. popular. In fact, Ford was (26).................. that he could not make enough of them, so he developed a new, quicker system to use in his factory. Cars moved slowly along a line of people. Workers added the same part to each car that passed by, finishing with a completed car at the end.

[--- Table Start ---]
| 21 | A understood | B known | C accepted | D heard |
| 22 | A set | B made | C put | D ended |
| 23 | A reason | B ability | C custom | D goal |
| 24 | A familiar | B usual | C ordinary | D basic |
| 25 | A incredibly | B nearly | C completely | D absolutely |
| 26 | A realising | B admitting | C getting | D finding |
[--- Table End ---]

questions.explanation:
B. known
“be best known for” 为固定搭配，意为 “因…… 最闻名”，符合亨利・福特以造车闻名的语境。
A. understood（理解）、C. accepted（接受）、D. heard（听说）均不与 “for” 构成 “闻名” 的含义。
拓展：“know” 的过去分词 “known” 常用搭配：be known as（作为…… 闻名）、be known to（为…… 所知）。

A. set
“set up Ford Motor Company” 表示 “成立福特汽车公司”，“set up” 为固定短语，意为 “建立”。
B. made（制作）、C. put（放置）、D. ended（结束）均不与 “company” 构成 “成立” 的动作。
拓展：“set up” 常见搭配：set up a business（创办企业）、set up a team（组建团队）。

D. goal
“Ford's goal was to change that” 指 “福特的目标是改变现状”，“goal” 表示 “目标”，符合语境。
A. reason（原因）、B. ability（能力）、C. custom（习俗）均不与 “to do sth.” 构成 “目的” 的含义。
拓展：“achieve a goal（实现目标）”“set a goal（设定目标）” 为常见搭配。

C. ordinary
“for ordinary people” 意为 “对普通人而言”，“ordinary” 表示 “普通的”，与 “wealthy（富有的）” 形成对比。
A. familiar（熟悉的）、B. usual（通常的）、D. basic（基本的）均不与 “people” 搭配表示 “普通人”。
拓展：“ordinary people”=“common people”，如 “ordinary people's lives（普通人的生活）”。

A. incredibly
“incredibly popular” 表示 “极其受欢迎”，“incredibly” 修饰形容词，强调程度。
B. nearly（几乎）、C. completely（完全）、D. absolutely（绝对）均不符合 “受欢迎程度” 的语境。
拓展：“incredibly”=“extremely”，如 “incredibly successful（极其成功）”。

D. finding
“finding that he could not make enough” 表示 “发现生产数量不足”，“finding” 为现在分词，符合时态逻辑。
A. realising（意识到）、B. admitting（承认）、C. getting（获得）均不与 “that 从句” 构成 “发现事实” 的含义。
拓展：“find + that 从句” 表示 “发现……”，如 “find that the plan works（发现计划可行）”。
